description: Create a current Granoflow task in pending state with common structured fields. Ordinary creation never accepts startedAt or other historical physical fields. AI execution stays pending until verified completion, records its actual start through granoflow_task_history_mutate, and never claims the human doing focus slot. AI and automation callers must provide authoringEvidence for an action/outcome title, plain-language review, and exact real-analogy and concrete-example excerpts. Invalid evidence returns task_authoring_quality_failed before any task write. A milestone-bound task without dueAt inherits the selected milestone deadline; an explicit later date fails closed. Tags not in the local catalog are skipped automatically. Defaults to dry-run.

authoringEvidence.description: Required for AI or automation task creation: declare an action/outcome title, plain-language review, and exact analogy/example excerpts from the description.

completionSource.description: When ai or human, attach the matching AI/人工 source tag after ensuring it exists. Omit or unknown means no source tag.

dryRun.description: When true, previews the request without writing.

dueAt.description: Explicit task deadline. When milestoneId is supplied and this is omitted, the task inherits the selected milestone deadline. A later explicit date fails closed.

status.description: Ordinary current-task creation starts pending; omit or pass pending.

name: granoflow_task_create_structured
